a261020p1.summary: Neolix Technologies Co., a Chinese maker of driverless delivery vehicles, raised $400 million to fuel its global expansion.
a261020p1.title: Chinese robovan maker Neolix raised a $400M Series E led by Boyu, taking total funding to $1.4B+; it operates 30K+ vehicles in 300+ cities across 20 countries (Saritha Rai/Bloomberg)

a261020p10.summary: Estonia-based Blackwall, which builds web traffic security tools for hosting providers, said on Tuesday that it has raised $100 million at a $2.2 billion valuation.
a261020p10.title: Estonia-based web traffic security company Blackwall raised a $100M Series C led by AVP at a $2.2B valuation, after raising a $49.2M Series B in March 2025 (Ram Iyer/TechCrunch)

a261020p11.summary: Britain's competition regulator said on Tuesday it was seeking to loosen Apple's grip on contactless payments by proposing …
a261020p11.title: The UK CMA proposes measures requiring Apple to provide easier access to its contactless tech and reduce access fees, with a consultation until November 17 (Paul Sandle/Reuters)

a261020p12.summary: The leaked draft bill is weaker than the FRONTIER Act and makes Anthropic's safety-first pitch ring hollow
a261020p12.title: Anthropic's leaked federal AI bill draws widespread criticism from AI safety advocates for being significantly weaker than the bipartisan FRONTIER Act (Shakeel Hashim/Transformer)

a261020p13.summary: An outage at Google Cloud knocked out banking services in the UK including Revolut Ltd. early on Tuesday.
a261020p13.title: Google says Cloud in its London region is "experiencing issues" starting on Monday at 23:08 PDT; a source says a major Revolut outage is due to Google Cloud (Bloomberg)

a261020p14.summary: Residents in remote region of Shaoguan hope country's AI infrastructure push will deliver boom that has long eluded them
a261020p14.title: Alibaba, Tencent, and Huawei are pouring billions into data centers in Shaoguan, a hinterland region with cheap power and a cool climate, angering some locals (Financial Times)

a261020p15.summary: Four founders of one of China's most promising artificial intelligence companies, Z.AI Co., worked on research …
a261020p15.title: Four Z.ai founders participated in a 2018 to 2021 research project co-funded by CGTRI, which the UK's MI5 said had "very strong ties" to China's main spy agency (Bloomberg)

a261020p2.summary: Documents obtained by The Intercept show the military is trying to deploy autonomous AI agents to hack its adversaries.
a261020p2.title: Leaked documents detail ECHOTRIBBLE, a nascent US Army Cyber Command program for agentic AI to autonomously spread across networks to find and eliminate targets (Sam Biddle/The Intercept)

a261020p3.summary: The fintech company raised over $841 million from its IPO — A financial-technology company backed by Ant International climbed …
a261020p3.title: Ant-backed Mynt, which runs mobile wallet app GCash, rose as much as 2.4% in Manila after raising $841M in the Philippines' largest-ever IPO, valuing it at ~$7B (Kimberley Kao/Wall Street Journal)

a261020p4.summary: Washington has blacklisted a Chinese venture firm established by ex-Microsoft Corp. AI scientist Lu Qi for alleged ties …
a261020p4.title: The US sanctions MiraclePlus, a Chinese VC firm founded by ex-Microsoft executive Lu Qi, over alleged ties to Zhisuan, accused of stealing Google's AI secrets (Bloomberg)

a261020p5.summary: Our latest model advances bring stronger capabilities for building and migrating software in low-resource programming languages such as COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic.
a261020p5.title: OpenAI says its new models show major performance leaps in low-resource legacy languages like COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic, used by banks and governments (OpenAI)

a261020p6.summary: London has slipped from seventh to last among 18 European capitals for median mobile download speed since 2021.
a261020p6.title: Analysis: London fell from 7th to last place out of 18 European capitals for median mobile download speed from 2021 to 2026; 5G adoption has outrun 5G capacity (Luke Kehoe/Ookla)

a261020p7.summary: Amazon.com Inc. said it will invest more than €16 billion ($17.9 billion) next year in Germany for operations including data centers …
a261020p7.title: Amazon pledges to spend €16B+ in Germany in 2027 on AWS and AI data centers, its Leo satellite program, Prime Video media production, and a Berlin robotics lab (Mark Bergen/Bloomberg)

a261020p8.summary: TikTok is primarily known for short-form video sharing, but it has also become a common place for many people to get news.
a261020p8.title: Survey: 20% of US adults regularly consume news on TikTok, up from just 3% in 2020; 39% of those aged 18 to 29 and 25% of those aged 30 to 49 do so regularly (Katerina Eva Matsa/Pew Research Center)

a261020p9.summary: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered more than 3 million of Nvidia's new RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards with a collective sticker price …
a261020p9.title: Sources: ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent ordered 3M+ of Nvidia's new RTX PRO 5500 GPUs worth $35B+, in a rush to secure less powerful, export-compliant chips (Reuters)
